The appendix deliberately covers “alte Etyma aus allen Dialekten” of European Romani rather than only the southeastern varieties of the dictionary proper, and cites every word in the shape it carries as a main entry there\. The scanned copy lacks the volume's front matter, so its abbreviation key and transcription description were not available; the source abbreviations used in the lists were resolved from the printed Literaturverzeichnis\.
references.progress: The etymological appendix “Etymologien” on printed pages 311--338 only, i.e. its four alphabetical word lists: Indische Etyma (pp. 311--328), Iranische Etyma (pp. 329--331), Armenische Etyma (pp. 331--332) and Griechische Etyma (pp. 333--338). Every printed entry in those lists is represented. Excludes the A--Z Romani-German-English dictionary (pp. 1--310), the German-Romani and English-Romani reverse indexes (pp. 339--362), the Variantengrammatik (pp. 363--417) and the Literaturverzeichnis (pp. 417--418).
